name: postfast
description: Schedule and publish social media posts with PostFast on X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram and Google Business Profile, answer comments on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Threads, and see how your posts performed. Claude fits each post to its network, holds it until you approve it, and shows you every comment reply before it is sent.
